title: OpenAI partners with six Indian education institutions, including IIT Delhi, IIM Ahmedabad, and AIIMS New Delhi, to provide ChatGPT Edu access to 100K+ students (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: OpenAI partners with six Indian education institutions, including IIT Delhi, IIM Ahmedabad, and AIIMS New Delhi, to provide ChatGPT Edu access to 100K+ students — OpenAI is expanding its footprint in India and moving into the country's higher-education system through partnerships with leading academic institutions.
